empty.body: Wine no. 1, Les Demoiselles from Château Coutet, is on pre-order: 1,660 Allocations, not one more.

card.footerNote: At each release: delivery to your door, free resale, or producer take-back.

actions.redeemSoon: repurchase opens once the producer funds are deposited
actions.redeemBody: The producer repurchases your {bottles} bottles of the {vintage} vintage, as per its repurchase commitment.
actions.redeemIrreversible: This operation is final: repurchased certificates are destroyed.
actions.redeemSuccess: Repurchase completed. The USDC is in your wallet.
actions.deliverBody: {bottles} bottles of the {vintage} vintage, in original wooden cases of 3. Proof of legal age is checked on receipt.
actions.deliverPrivacy: Your details are never published: only their fingerprint (hash) is recorded on-chain with your request.
actions.deliverSuccess: Delivery request received. Our logistics team will contact you to arrange delivery.
actions.panelQuestion: What would you like to do with this vintage?
actions.deliverDesc: Receive your bottles at home, in their original wooden cases.
actions.redeemDesc: The producer repurchases your bottles on request. Payment usually within 72 hours.
actions.sellDesc: Entrust the sale of your bottles to our dedicated service.
actions.sellModalBody: This service will open soon: it will let you entrust the sale of your bottles. Terms and conditions will be published before it opens.
actions.sellModalNote: In the meantime, your certificates remain freely transferable from wallet to wallet.
actions.redeemSettledNote: The producer funds are deposited: your repurchase can be executed immediately.
actions.requestBody: Repurchase is not automatic: your request is sent to the producer, who approves it and deposits the funds. You then confirm the repurchase here and receive the USDC in your wallet. Usual processing time: within 72 hours.
actions.requestNote: Your request goes directly to our team, with your wallet address attached for identification. Nothing personal is published on-chain.
actions.requestSent: Request sent. The producer usually responds within 72 hours.
actions.sendFailed: Your details could not be transmitted automatically.
